title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of Austral Refrigeration Holdings Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths Limited proposed to acquire the remote commercial refrigeration business of Austral Refrigeration Holdings Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the following markets: (i) the national market for the manufacture and supply of remote refrigerated display cases; (ii) the national market for the design and installation of remote refrigeration systems; and (iii) region-based markets for the maintenance of remote refrigeration systems.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant market. Factors informing this view included; (i) the merger parties did not overlap in any relevant market; and (ii) in each relevant market, a number of alternatives to Austral existed such that any attempt by Woolworths to foreclose its retail rivals' access to remote refrigeration equipment and services was unlikely to be successful.
